sources.title: Running Qwen 3.5 Locally on a Single GPU: Complete Setup Guide
sources.snippet: Running Qwen 3.5 locally is a powerful way to access a massive language model while keeping everything private and completely under your control. In this guide, the model was hosted on a single H200 GPU VM, accessed securely from your local machine using SSH port forwarding, and served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp).

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B LoRA Fine-tuning on Step-3.5-Flash-SFT - GitHub
sources.snippet: This experiment validates whether a single H100 can efficiently fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B on general agent/coding/reasoning data that the base model has never seen before, using a large LoRA rank to compensate for the domain gap.
